_README: Standard v3 input (engine v3.0). Fill once per company. null = not retrieved: the engine marks the check [unverified] and excludes it from B — never guess a number to fill a slot. Fields marked (v3) are new or changed vs v2. A required field that is missing makes the engine refuse to render rather than default.
macro: optional overrides of the season's block (rf, erp_val, hurdle, ...); echoed in output

financials._source: Annual-report ten-year table first; Screener as cross-check. Reconcile before writing.
financials.contingent_liabilities: AR note; null if not retrieved
financials.group_loans: (v3) check 6 limb 2 — loans/advances to group entities
financials.roce_5y: 5-yr average, decimal (state the basis; if two bases straddle a bar, use the lower)
financials.guided_growth: (v3) decimal or null — D3 middle band
financials.ebitda_margin_5y: (v3) list of 5 annual EBITDA margins — A3 auto (else score A3 manually)
financials.incremental_roic_3y: (v3) dNOPAT / dCapital employed, 3 yrs — A5 auto
financials.leveraged: bool — adds Altman Z > 2.99 to check 10
financials._US_fields: US only: pretax_income, nonoperating_income, equity, cfo_ni_5y_avg, loss_maker, cfo_less_sbc_latest2, dso_start/end, contingencies, contingencies_not_estimable_material, related_party_loans, capitalised_costs_growth_5y, revenue_growth_5y, cash_pct_assets, diluted_shares_cagr_3y, sbc_pct_cfo (see usa_engine_v1 schema)

check_verification: (v3) {"5": "pass" | "fail" | "unverified"} — fills a check the numbers could not (document-verified). Contradicting a computed result refuses the render.
sector_variant: omit, or "financial" — then supply forensic_fs (8 checks) and the valuation fields in _financial_variant
forensic_fs: financial only: list of 8 {n, check, result: pass|fail|unverified, number}
treasury_income_exception: true only for treasury income of a NET-CASH company (check 4 noted, not failed)

ownership.median_daily_value: (v3 name) Rs Cr median, not one day — state the session count; US: market.median_daily_dollar_value_usd

pledge.pledge_pct_shares: (v3) pledged shares / shares outstanding — check 9 floor 0.5%

pit.net_buy_mcap_pct: (v3) trailing-4Q net promoter buying (+) / selling (-) as % of Mcap, open-market + block/bulk only; exclude ESOP, warrant conversion, inter-se transfers

credibility._note: (v3) C5. Most recent quarter first; score 0-2 per call; null = no outcome yet (excluded, weights re-based). Or score_10 directly, or executable:false.

valuation.margin_end: after linear fade to the 10-yr average
valuation.growth: explicit-period decimal, <= min(industry CAGR, 12%) unless history justifies more
valuation.net_cash: Rs Cr, negative if net debt (required)
valuation.beta: (v3) REQUIRED — measured 2-yr weekly vs Nifty 500 (>= 40 obs) or the industry beta
valuation.debt_wt: (v3) D/(D+E) actual or target — optional; net-debt names without it are derived from net debt / (net debt + Mcap); net-cash names are all-equity
valuation.multiples_range: [low, high] per share: justified peer multiple +-15% x FY+1 metric
valuation.pe_10y_median: (v3) D4 auto — own 10-yr median P/E (missing = D4 1 by rule)
valuation._financial_variant: supply instead: conservative_central, conservative_range [lo,hi], hurdle_price (excess-return model value at 15%), multiples_range, reverse_model {implied_growth|note}

prices: optional {stock_weekly: [[date, close]...], index_weekly: [...]} — engine regresses beta (>= 40 obs)
bear_triggers: (v3) REQUIRED list of documented independent bear triggers; [] = none. Bear weight = 25% + 5pp each, cap 45%.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.weight: base:bull ratio preserved and rescaled to 1 - bear

f5_skipped: (v3) true at SCREEN when the marquee screen is not run — F rescales from F1-F4. Refused at FULL.

manual_scores._README: 0-2, decimals allowed. Engine-only tests (A1 D1 D3 E1 E2 E3 E4) are refused here. Auto-when-data tests (A2 A3 A5 A6 C1 C5 C6 D2 D4 D5 E5) may be supplied when inputs are missing; an override of an auto score is listed in the output. Price-dependent manual tests take {"today": x, "trigger": y}.

gates._note: G1 and G3 are computed; G4 is computed when the auditor fields are complete. Supply G2, G5 (and G4 if not computed; G6 private only) as 'pass' or 'FAIL — reason'. A missing gate caps the tier at WATCH.

claimed: (v3) optional {A,B,C,F: x, D/E: {today, trigger}, Q, P_trigger, P_today, tier} — the numbers the narrative prints; any mismatch refuses the render
